text: {"memo": "AMAZON.COM, INC. (AMZN) delivered robust performance in FY2024, generating revenue of $637.96\u202fbillion, net income of $59.25\u202fbillion, operating income of $68.59\u202fbillion, diluted EPS of $5.53 and operating cash flow of $115.88\u202fbillion. Compared with FY2023, the company\u2019s revenue rose to $637.96\u202fbillion from $574.78\u202fbillion, while net income more than doubled to $59.25\u202fbillion from $30.43\u202fbillion. Operating income improved to $68.59\u202fbillion from $36.85\u202fbillion, and operating cash flow increased to $115.88\u202fbillion from $84.95\u202fbillion. Diluted EPS climbed to $5.53 from $2.90, reflecting strong profitability and efficient capital management. The expansion of both top‑line and bottom‑line metrics, coupled with a significant lift in operating cash flow, underscores Amazon\u2019s continued execution of its growth strategy and disciplined cost control. View: Strong fundamentals and cash generation support a buy rating."}
